components.name: Tool Card
components.description: Index grid card linking to a tool's detail page; glass surface, lifts with a gold glow on hover.
components.html: DESIGN№ 01ImpeccableDesign taste for AI coding agentsREAD ENTRY →
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 26px 26px 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025); border: 1px solid rgba(244,242,239,0.1); border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .25s ease-out, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .25s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(244,242,239,0.24); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -18px rgba(224,191,145,.3); } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-chip { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #e0bf91; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(224,191,145,.3); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(224,191,145,.13); } .ds-num { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #948d82; } .ds-card-name { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.35rem; color: #f4f2ef; } .ds-card-tag { font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #c4bfb6; } .ds-card-open { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #948d82; }

components.name: Category Tab (active)
components.description: Filter tab with animated gold underline and soft glow when active.
components.css: .ds-tab { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; position: relative; padding: 10px 14px 14px; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f4f2ef; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: #e0bf91; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 12px 1px rgba(224,191,145,.13); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0bf91; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Command Block + Copy
components.description: Raised command surface with gold copy button; fills and pulse-rings on copy.
components.css: .ds-specimen { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; background: #131110; border: 1px solid rgba(244,242,239,0.1); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-specimen code { flex: 1; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #f4f2ef; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-copy { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e0bf91; border-radius: 10px; color: #e0bf91; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out, color .15s ease-out; } .ds-copy:hover { background: #e0bf91; color: #0a0908; }

components.name: Curator's Note
components.description: Mono italic pull-quote behind a 2px gold rule — the one place ember touches prose. Also appears as full-row grid asides after tools 03 and 06 (unfiltered log only).
components.html: ✎ The final gate before anything ships with my name on it.

components.name: Repo Link
components.description: External mono link with ↗; underline on hover only.
components.css: .ds-repo { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e0bf91; text-decoration: none; } .ds-repo:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Portrait
components.description: The curator's photo: one square file, circled and gold-ringed in CSS.
components.css: .ds-avatar { width: 68px; height: 68px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #e0bf91; padding: 3px; object-fit: cover; background: #131110; }

narrative.overview: A warm dark instrument panel under a drifting aurora: near-black warm ground with three slow-breathing glow fields (gold, copper, bronze) providing all the atmosphere, glass-edged rounded cards floating above, and one accent doing all the talking — Xavier's brand gold #e0bf91, the same gold as his LinkedIn banner and the ring around his portrait. Layout follows claude.com/plugins: card grid on the index, a full detail page per tool, category tabs kept.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black sheet (#0a0908) with a fixed aurora layer drifting behind everything (60–90s cycles)
Glass cards: 2.5% white fill, 1px warm-white border, 16px radius; hover lifts with a gold-tinted glow
One accent, two treatments: gold outline = information, gold fill = action
Warmed neutrals throughout — no cool greys anywhere
The curator is present: portrait in a gold ring in the hero and colophon

rules.name: The One-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only non-neutral hue that ever touches content. Differentiate by treatment (outline vs fill), never by adding a colour.

rules.name: The Atmosphere-Not-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Colour lives in the background field and small signals — never in gradient text, coloured panels, or neon outlines.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every grey carries a warm cast. A cool blue-grey next to this gold reads as a mistake.

rules.name: The Measured-Mono Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono appears only where the world measures, labels, or codes. Body prose is never mono.

dos: Do let the aurora carry all atmosphere — content surfaces stay glass-neutral.
Do keep hover physics consistent: lift + border-brighten + one soft glow, 0.25s ease-out.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere: static aurora, no lifts, instant reveals.
Do keep every functional text ≥0.72rem (chips 0.66rem are the single exception).
donts: Don't use gradient text, neon outlines, scanlines, or grid/graph backgrounds (user-rejected).
Don't add a second accent hue or put aurora colours on content elements.
Don't cast shadows except the card hover glow, active-tab glow, and copy pulse-ring.
Don't hardcode GitHub stars, install counts, or any metric the log cannot verify.
